Web Hosting and Website Services Stretton

If you’re located in Stretton and want to get your business up and running with an online presence, you need someone to talk to about getting your business online.  A simple search will give you hundreds of results, and it can be pretty daunting to know what to do and who to choose as your hosting service to keep your website and emails working.

I’m a computer repair technician with 25 years experience and over 10 years of experience in website hosting services. This gives me an advantage over other hosting providers because I’ll never have to refer you to a computer technician. I will manage your website hosting, provide technical support, and be your go-to person for all your computer and website issues.

I have my own dedicated server located in Australia, not some cheap server located in an overseas country where a lot of the bigger companies who offer really cheap pricing have their servers.  A lot of the time some of the bigger companies will load 1 server with thousands of websites and if there is a problem with 1 of those sites, it can have an impact on your website loading or it’s online reputation causing some of your emails to go through to spam folders.

I have my own dedicated server located in Australia, not some cheap server located in an overseas country where a lot of the bigger companies who offer really cheap pricing have their servers.  A lot of the time some of the bigger companies will load 1 server with thousands of websites and if there is a problem with 1 of those sites, it can have an impact on your website loading or it’s online reputation causing some of your emails to go through to spam folders.

Check out our complete list of services that we offer and check out our reviews on the about us page.  If you have a business in Stretton and would like your site to be listed on our local business directory page for Stretton Please go to the contact us page and submit your local business to be featured on our page for the area.  Of course we have also teamed up with a local Security Camera company that can help set up your home or business for CCTV also if you live in the Stretton area.

What is Website Hosting, why do I need it and why is it Important who I choose?

Web hosting keeps your website up and running 24/7 so visitors can always access it. Without hosting, your site would only be available on your own computer.  All the content that makes up your website, like text, images, videos, code files, etc. need to be stored somewhere. Web hosting provides that storage on a server.  Quality web hosting optimises your website’s performance by providing adequate resources and fast loading speeds. This is crucial for user experience and search engine rankings.  Good hosting protects your website from hacks, malware and other threats by implementing security measures like SSL, firewalls, and regular malware scanning.  As your website gets more traffic or you add new features, quality hosting lets you easily scale up your resources to accommodate that growth.

These are the signs to look out for with other WordPress hosting providers who offer Cheaper Rates:

  • 1. Downtime and server issues
  • 2. Slow loading speeds due to companies using cheaper and overloaded.
  • 3. Security and Compliance issues - leaves open to hacks and data breaches.
  • 4. Poor customer service - Have you ever spoken to an overseas call center before and heard robotic scripted responses?  Nothing frustrates me more than not speaking to someone located in Australia who understands us.
  • 5. Misleading pricing - Low introductory rates that dramatically increase after the first year but they know it's harder for you to leave once your locked in.
